Absolutely NO curls, dog ears, rolls, folds, lifted corners, internal paper flaps, raised rails, embossed frame or triangular fold shadows ANYWHERE. Each individual card is one continuous flat paper sheet. Preserve ALL other image1 content exactly. This is a linework consistency fix only. High quality, sharp professional illustration.
